scope: Original input production and BunnyHouse doorway; supplemental technical source only
sceneIdentity: BuildSettings scenes[3] = Assets/_Game/[Scenes]/BunnyHouse.unity -> level3; level2 is BeaverHouse and also has a CentralForest doorway. Destination name alone cannot identify the route.

doorway.acceptance: Serialized original geometry only; loaded collider/state, collision and scene travel not exercised

inputProduction: InputHelper.Awake gets Rewired player via GetPlayer(0), finds original joystick/touch helpers and binds kingofjoysticks custom-controller callbacks. CheckInputsRewired consumes original action axes and zeroes the axis if all normal providers return zero. No synthetic axis API is authorized by this finding.
joystickLifecycle: Pinned original Auto-asmdef-SecondPass.dll: TheKingOfJoysticks.Awake unconditionally Destroy(gameObject) then ret. A serialized enabled component is therefore not evidence of a usable runtime joystick; never create/enable a replacement.
joystickConsumers: MouseDown only sets insideArea; UpdateMouseMode requires UnityEngine.Input.GetMouseButtonDown/get_mousePosition and ValidateMouseMode. Touch mode reads Input.touches. Neither path implements an ordinary drag/pointer motion callback for bridge input. GetAxisValueCallback returns zero if the original joystick is absent or not inUse; otherwise reads its real axes. Do not write joystick fields, replace callbacks or feed the custom controller directly.

serializedKeyboardConfiguration.interpretation: Original keyboard maps include WASD/arrows. runInBackground does not by itself establish Rewired focus/input eligibility. Current runtime focus, configuration and maps must be observed separately. Export preserves both serialized players; no assumed serialized ID0 mapping.

runtimeDiagnostic: tools/probe/ForestProbe.cs dump-travel now reads focus/runInBackground/actual Rewired focus configuration, InputHelper.FullAxis, original player identity/movement/transition/waypoint fields, loaded door identity/transition, and player/door Collider2D bounds/tag/layer/attached-body/simulated state. Does not inject input, focus windows, enable controls, query availability/chance, move objects or invoke events.
regressions: Never bind a doorway by destination label alone: BeaverHouse and BunnyHouse both target CentralForest; bind BuildSettings scene, source file, original object and transform chain.
Serialized enabled joystick is not runtime eligibility: original Awake destroys it.
Native player runInBackground and Rewired ignore-unfocused are separate gates.
Do not assume Rewired serialized player ID equals GetPlayer argument; observe actual original player identity.
remaining: No safe background native keyboard transport has been demonstrated. Before another dependency replay, investigate the public Rewired background-input configuration and a target-specific native keyboard transport. Any QA-only focus-policy delta must be source-pinned, documented as a replaced harness dependency and restored; it is not proof of unchanged original focus handling. Do not forge focus, write InputHelper/joystick axes, create controllers, replace callbacks or bypass movement/doorway/story guards. Observe actual native input->Rewired axis->original Player physics->real collision.
unchangedAcceptance: Candidate10/15 exact native pairs and candidate25 intro cleanup retained. No CentralForest, tutorial120, notebook225:195, inventory, visual, full-source or editorial acceptance added.
